decision_label: GENERALLY ROBUST WITH A MATERIAL SUBGROUP LIMITATION

decision_policy.A: Every sufficiently populated primary group has ROC-AUC >= 0.70, AP >= 2 times its prevalence, recall >= 0.20 at the frozen threshold, and each dimension's ROC-AUC range <= 0.12.
decision_policy.B: Decision A fails, but every sufficiently populated primary group has ROC-AUC >= 0.60, AP >= 1.25 times its prevalence, and recall >= 0.10; classify as generally robust with a material subgroup limitation.
decision_policy.C: At least one sufficiently populated primary group fails the Decision B minimums; classify as substantial robustness failure.

stage14_subgroup_comparison.reason: The frozen Stage 14 model was trained on the complete original-train split, which includes both current DEV_TRAIN and DEV_VAL customers. Applying it to DEV_VAL would be in-sample and is not compatible with the Stage 17A hierarchy; no leakage-safe saved Stage 14 DEV_VAL predictions exist.
